sentences.text:
(Presently Lodged In Central Jail Jodhpur).
 ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Puna W/o Veer Singh, Aged About 20 Years, B/c- Banjara,
 R/o- Sadera P.s., Narden, Dist. Bidisa Madhya Pradesh At  Present- Chainpura Pipali Mandore, Jodhpur.
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mukhtiyar Khan, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 18/10/2023 The present bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.403/2023 of Police Station Kudi Bhagtasani,
District Jodhpur for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 506 of the IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that false case has been lodged against the present petitioner and he has nothing to do with the alleged crime.
The petitioner is in the judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused- petitioner.

Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the prayer for bail.
[2023:RJ-JD:35656] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-12419/2023] I have considered the arguments advanced before me and carefully gone through the case diary.

According to the perusal of statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.,
specific allegation of committing rape has been levelled against the present petitioner, therefore, this Court is not inclined to grant benefit of bail to the present petitioner.
In the above circumstances, the bail application filed by the petitioner is hereby rejected.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 117-raksha/-
